title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE EVERYONE'S DEATH TIMER? ⏳💀 (Animated Short Film)
description:
What if you woke up one morning and suddenly saw glowing digital countdown clocks floating above everyone's head? Years, months, days... ticking away down to the exact second of their death.

When Pip notices a stranger's timer plummeting to just 12 seconds on a crowded subway platform, he realizes he can physically rewrite fate. But knowing when someone's story ends isn't a superpower. It's an agonizing burden.
